title: Ship Layouts & Docking Connections
selected_by_owner: Owner directed the next MMHT cycle and supplied the Map Maker Downtime handoff.

in_scope: Standalone authoring of deck and station anchor markers and explicit docking or access links
Berth clearance check against current authored deck hull bounds, and unresolved endpoint diagnostics
Lantern Post map-side roles and revision-qualified, audience-filtered location references

evidence.validation: Generated HTML executed in JSDOM with native Canvas. Deck Builder and 12N workspace regression passed. Strict TypeScript reported the pre-existing MCS-03 operationId narrowing error only.

evidence.boundaries: Standalone offline map authoring. Review evidence comes from a browser harness. Physical mobile-device behavior and a receiving Downtime tester are pending.

next_action: Review docking and Lantern Post in the HTML. Use feedback for Base Layouts & Blueprints when MMHT-03 is selected.
successor_rule: Requires owner direction to start the next standalone review cycle.
